brief: A recipe manager as a transformation timeline — ingredients flow through steps and combine into the dish

dominant_strengths: Warm cream/saffron/olive palette evokes the dish itself, creating semantic color harmony tied to the recipe theme
Clear hierarchy: bold serif title, restrained sans labels, and numbered step badges guide the eye through the timeline
Bracket-style connector lines from ingredients to steps make the 'transformation flow' metaphor literal and legible
dominant_weaknesses: Connector lines are static and ambiguous — multiple ingredients merge into single dots without showing which feeds which step
Final 'Golden Perfection' card floats disconnected; the convergence moment that should feel climactic is visually equal to side cards
Step cards are uniform rectangles — no visual rhythm or escalation matching the recipe's building intensity from bloom to mantecatura
fix_priorities: Differentiate connector paths per ingredient (color/curve) so the flow metaphor actually maps ingredients to specific steps
Elevate the final dish card with scale, glow, or terminal node treatment to dramatize convergence
Introduce subtle motion or progressive reveal so the timeline feels like transformation, not a static org chart
Vary step card density or accent color to express heat/time escalation across the four stages
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral warmth and reflective recipe-as-journey concept lead, but behavioral clarity suffers because the mapping between ingredients and steps is decorative rather than functional.
rationale.intent_fit: It expresses the transformation-timeline brief conceptually but stops short of truly showing ingredients flowing and combining — the connections are suggestive, not causal.
